verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a managed visa service with an online case-tracking platform. Because it sits inside an HR/payroll SaaS that could ship workflow automations, the axis applies. The evidence only shows fixed automated renewal reminders and expiry alerts. Nothing shows user-defined automations that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
